claims.value: Qwen3Guard-Stream is a safety moderation model built upon Qwen3, featuring a token-level classification head for real-time safety monitoring during incremental text generation. It supports 119 languages and dialects.
claims.evidence: Qwen3Guard-Stream, which incorporates a token-level classification head for real-time safety monitoring during incremental text generation.
Streaming detection requires streaming token IDs as input, making it best suited for use alongside language models that share Qwen3's tokenizer.

claims.value: The model enables three-tiered severity classification, categorizing outputs into safe, controversial, and unsafe levels, and supports 119 languages and dialects.
claims.evidence: Supports 119 languages and dialects, ensuring robust performance in global and cross-lingual applications.
